beginner.summary: For Python developers, data engineers and search engineers who are new to Weaviate and want to build semantic search applications on it. Covers running Weaviate locally in Docker, connecting with the Python v4 client over REST and gRPC, designing collections and properties, importing objects with module vectorizers or your own vectors, batch imports, near_text and near_vector queries, BM25 and hybrid search, filters, aggregations, generative search, cross-references, schema changes, Weaviate Cloud sandbox clusters and multimodal collections, ending with a semantic FAQ search capstone.
prerequisites: Writes Python 3.10 or later scripts with functions, dictionaries, virtual environments and pip
Runs Docker and Docker Compose commands and reads container logs
Understands at a high level what an embedding is and why similar texts have nearby vectors
outcomes: Run Weaviate in Docker and connect to it with the Python v4 client locally and on Weaviate Cloud
Design collections with typed properties, a vectorizer module and a generative module, and import data with batching and error checks
Answer questions with near_text, near_vector, BM25, hybrid search, filters, aggregations and generative search
Build and demonstrate a small semantic search application with measured relevance on a labelled question set

Covers cluster internals with shards and Raft, replication factor and tunable consistency, async replication and repairs, the Helm chart on Kubernetes, scaling and replica movement, memory and disk planning, Prometheus metrics and Grafana dashboards, load testing, multi-vector late-interaction embeddings, compression at scale, high-throughput ingestion, disaster recovery, hardening, audit of RBAC, Weaviate Cloud operations, upgrades, the Query Agent, self-hosted inference modules and incident drills, ending with a production platform capstone on Kubernetes.
prerequisites: Completed the intermediate level or has designed Weaviate collections with named vectors, compression, multi-tenancy, backups and RBAC

outcomes: Deploy, scale and upgrade multi-node Weaviate clusters on Kubernetes with replication and tuned consistency
Size memory and disk for a workload and keep recall, latency and cost within targets using index and compression choices
Monitor Weaviate with Prometheus and Grafana, and recover from node loss, read-only shards and data loss with tested runbooks
Secure and govern a shared Weaviate platform with TLS, network policies, RBAC reviews and controlled upgrades
